description:
Role: Salesforce Platform Developer
 Location: Lansing,MI 48901 also Remote 
 Duration: 12+ Months
 Experience Needed: 10+ Years
  Updates
  IMPORTANT - please provide candidate's Linkedin and Trailblazer profile in the notes of your submission. If these are not included, the candidate will not be considered . *3 rounds of interviews Zoom or in person in Lansing 
  
 Position details
 Salesforce Platform Developer
  
 Required Skills
 • 5+ years of Salesforce Platform development experience
 • Strong Apex, LWC, and SOQL/SOSL skills
 • Solid understanding of governor limits, data security model, and OWD
 • Experience with REST/SOAP API integrations and Salesforce DX Preferred Skills Required Certifications
 • Platform App Builder
 • Platform Developer I (PD1)
 • Platform Developer II (PD2)
 • JavaScript Developer I Responsibilities
 • Develop and maintain custom solutions using Apex (triggers, batch, queueable, scheduled jobs)
 • Build Lightning Web Components (LWC) for rich user experiences
 • Design and implement integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Named Credentials
 • Build automated processes using Flows, Validation Rules, and Formula Fields
 • Manage deployments using SFDX, VS Code, and CI/CD pipelines
 • Enforce Salesforce security best practices (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules)
 • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions Expected Deliverable(s) Deliver scalable custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, and declarative automation Build secure and reusable integration components using REST/SOAP APIs and Platform Events Execute source-controlled deployments through SFDX and CI/CD pipelines Ensure adherence to Salesforce governor limits, security model, and coding best practices Provide testing, documentation, and production support for platform enhancements


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
